title: 7th Sitting of First session of 2026

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/7/1/2026).
From the Speaker's desk: the reply to the Presidential Address, under Article 33(b) of the Standing Orders of the Majlis.
Preliminary debate on the Bill to amend the Land Transport Act (Law No. 5/2009), submitted by North Galolhu MP Mohamed Ibrahim.
Unfinished business: continuing the debate on the National Service Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by South Kulhudhuffushi MP Faruhath Mohamed.
Report of the Rules Committee on the matter of extending the period for applying the regulations listed in Schedules 1 and 2 of the General Regulations Act (Law No. 6/2008).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to deliver the reply to the Presidential Address, begin debate on a Land Transport Act amendment, continue the National Service Bill and take up a report on extending old regulations.
